issue.title: Pomodoro sub-bullet moves and named Pomodoros
issue.description: `<ctrl+shift+m>` on a Pomodoro sub-bullet moves that bullet — and, with a count, the next N sibling bullets — into another open Pomodoro in the same note, or into a new named Pomodoro created just below the current one, and the Pomodoro glossary entry documents named Pomodoros and this keymap.

issue.title: Pure named-Pomodoro model, discovery, and planner
issue.description: pomodoro-move-engine: add the named-Pomodoro grammar, entry/bullet-context model, sibling target discovery with count and clamping, and the pure same-file move planner to bob-navigation-hotkeys, all exported and unit tested with no UI or routing change.

issue.title: Picker, routing, and commit
issue.description: pomodoro-move-ui: add the destination picker rows and modal with typed create-new-Pomodoro support, route `Ctrl+Shift+M` to the Pomodoro move when the cursor is on a sub-bullet, and commit the planned move as one guarded editor transaction with a reporting notice.

issue.title: Docs, version, sync, and glossary
issue.description: pomodoro-move-docs: bump the plugin manifest, extend the bob-plugins README, deploy with `bob plugins sync`, rewrite the Pomodoro glossary strand to cover named Pomodoros and the keymap, and regenerate sase memory.

payload.entry: Added named-Pomodoro grammar (parsePomodoroEntryLine, normalizePomodoroName, formatPomodoroEntryLine), collectPomodoroEntries/findPomodoroBulletContext, sibling discovery (discoverMovablePomodoroBulletTargets), and the same-file move planner (planPomodoroBulletMove) plus supporting capture/remove/rebase helpers to plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/main.js, all exported via helpers. Added full unit test coverage in scripts/test-navigation-hotkeys.cjs (parsing, normalization, entry collection, context/discovery incl. grandchild promotion and clamping, move planning incl. new/existing destinations, duplicate merging, placeholder repair on both source and destination, stale-target/invalid-destination rejection, and an out-and-back round-trip). Ran code-review; fixed one real bug it found (lone-placeholder destination was blanked out when the moved block merged away as a duplicate) with a regression test. npm test (559 tests) and npm run validate (6/6 plugins) both pass in bob-plugins; git status clean and pushed. No UI, routing, manifest, or existing behavior changed. epic-symbols check: none.
Implemented Pomodoro bullet move picker/routing/commit path in bob-plugins; verified npm test and npm run validate pass; epic-symbols reported no leftovers.

Verified npm test and npm run validate pass in bob-plugins; ran bob plugins sync against the linked repo and confirmed bob-navigation-hotkeys 1.28.0 is synced; ran sase memory init --no-commit after updating the Pomodoro glossary; epic-symbols reported none.

payload.description: Epic bob-cli-16 added the named-Pomodoro grammar (parsePomodoroEntryLine / formatPomodoroEntryLine in bob-navigation-hotkeys) that this task should mirror, and deferred this item in its plan's Out of scope section.

payload.entry:
Verified all three phases against the source, the commits, and a live run, then checked integration.

VERIFY: Read every child note and the three epic commits in bob-plugins (117e33c engine, 87d38d6 picker/routing/commit, 9ba28c1 docs/version) plus 78e219b in bob-cli. Confirmed in plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/main.js: the named-Pomodoro grammar (POMODORO_NAME_SEPARATOR/POMODORO_NAME_MAX_LENGTH at :64, parsePomodoroEntryLine :6451, normalizePomodoroName :6510, formatPomodoroEntryLine :6533), collectPomodoroEntries :6544, findPomodoroBulletContext :6629, discoverMovablePomodoroBulletTargets :6663, planPomodoroBulletMove :6798, createPomodoroBulletMovePickerRows :7124, buildPomodoroBulletMoveNotice :7184, renderPomodoroBulletMovePickerRow :10246, PomodoroBulletMovePickerModal :10399, and the routing/session/commit trio openTaskMoveOrPomodoroBulletPicker :21648 / openPomodoroBulletMovePicker :21660 / commitPomodoroBulletMoveSession :21986. All nine pure helpers are exported from `helpers` (:24174-24185). Both Ctrl+Shift+M callers (:16785 command editorCallback, :19812 counted Vim path) go through the new dispatcher; the hotkey registration test still asserts {Ctrl,Shift}+M. The shared activeTaskMoveDestinationPicker slot guards both pickers with the same count-upgrade rule. styles.css adds only the is-new icon accent and is-status-unscheduled badge; is-unavailable/is-open follow the file's existing unstyled convention (also used by the yank-path picker). Ran npm test (567 pass, 0 fail) and npm run validate (6/6 plugins) in bob-plugins. manifest.json is 1.28.0, README line 16 row and line 22 version sentence and the line 104 Validation sentence all updated, and the deployed ~/bob/.obsidian/plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys copy is byte-identical to source at 1.28.0, so the phase-3 sync landed. sase/memory/glossary/pomodoro.md is the rewritten 102-word strand covering the grammar, named Pomodoros, past/current/planned, task links, and N<ctrl+shift+m>; `sase memory init --check` reports no drift.

INTEGRATE: Both repos are level with origin/master and clean; nothing landed in bob-plugins or bob-cli after the epic's own commits, so there was no post-start drift to reconcile. Checked every consumer of the Pomodoro entry grammar for tolerance of the new ` — NAME` suffix instead: task-status-cycler (isPomodoroTaskLine/findNextPomodoroLine key off the column-0 checkbox only; getPomodoroCursorTargetCh still lands inside `()`), block-id-prompt (isPomodoroEntryLine matches on the whole-line placeholder-or-range test), and bob-navigation-hotkeys' own isOpenPomodoroLedgerEntryLine / isPomodoroNavigationTaskLine / collectOpenPomodoroRanges. Verified the plan's two explicit "verify this holds, do not fix it" claims empirically rather than by inspection alone: bob-ledger-tools splices by startCh/endCh, and changePomodoroLineUnits(+1) and offsetPomodoroLineRange(+1) both preserve the tail exactly ("- [ ] (**0920-0955** [t:: 35m]) — BODY", "- [ ] (**0921-0951** [t:: 30m]) — BODY"); and `bob pomodoro` on a named entry renders "2320-2350 — BODY" as predicted, since open_ledger_task takes the whole post-checkbox body, task_time_range finds the parenthetical, and clean_task strips the range and bracket fields. The two bob-ledger-tools em-dash-snippet commits that landed the same morning (bc738bb, 2ede7b2) are complementary — they are how ` — ` gets typed — and conflict with nothing here. No bob-cli or cross-plugin change was needed.

LAND: No child bead carried a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note. Of the plan's five out-of-scope items, three are already tracked by the project owner in ~/bob/bob.md (a "pomodoro bullet" glossary strand, the <ctrl+shift+]> migration scheduled 2026-09-01) or are speculative feature space (cross-note bullet moves, Pomodoro reordering, the up/down keymaps) and were deliberately not filed; the bob-cli verification item resolved to "holds, no change" above. The one item still worth doing became task bob-cli-1c (feature, small, ready): task-status-cycler's buildPomodoroCompletionPlan still inserts a bare POMODORO_PLACEHOLDER_LINE, so completing a named Pomodoro drops the name from its follow-on. It carries related links to this epic and to bob-cli-a, and its description flags that leaving the successor unnamed is a legitimate triage outcome. `sase bead epic-symbols bob-cli-16` reports no entries.
